request_text: I was told the account had been deleted, but I can still find traces in search, support, and analytics. Please handle them and disable any synchronization that could recreate them.
Bonjour, pourriez-vous m'envoyer une copie des données liées à mon compte ? Je l'utilise encore, merci de ne rien supprimer.
The account itself is gone, but an internal deleted-account record still shows my personal details. Please keep only the reference needed for retained records and remove the rest.
このメールアドレスに紐づくアカウントと個人データをすべて削除してください。完了したら連絡をお願いします。
